description: Defines the QpackOfflineDecoder class for decoding and verifying QPACK-encoded header data from files, used in testing and interoperability checks within the quic project.

classes.name: QpackOfflineDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding QPACK-encoded header data from files and verifying against expected headers, primarily used for testing and interoperability.

methods.name: DecodeAndVerifyOfflineData
methods.description: Reads encoded header blocks and expected headers from files, decodes, and verifies correctness.

methods.name: OnEncoderStreamError
methods.description: Handles encoder stream errors, as part of the delegate interface.

methods.name: ParseInputFilename
methods.description: Parses decoder parameters from input filename.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlocksFromFile
methods.description: Decodes header blocks from a specified file.

methods.name: VerifyDecodedHeaderLists
methods.description: Verifies decoded header lists against expected headers.

methods.name: ReadNextExpectedHeaderList
methods.description: Parses the next expected header list from data.

methods.name: CompareHeaderBlocks
methods.description: Compares two header lists, allowing for order differences.
